SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT o.web_order_id) AS distinct_ids, MIN(o.order_ts_utc) mn, MAX(o.order_ts_utc) mx
FROM fact_web_order o
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH o AS (
  SELECT * FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND status <> 'cancelled'
), l AS (
  SELECT f.receipt_id, COUNT(*) AS nlines, MAX(CASE WHEN p.category = 'ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_test,
         MAX(CASE WHEN s.store_id = 999 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS in999, COUNT(DISTINCT f.line_no) AS dl
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM o) GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS orders, COUNT(l.receipt_id) AS with_lines, SUM(COALESCE(l.has_test,0)) AS test_orders, SUM(COALESCE(l.in999,0)) AS s999,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.line_count <> l.nlines) AS linecount_mismatch, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.receipt_id IS NULL) AS nolines,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.status='processing') AS processing
FROM o LEFT JOIN l ON l.receipt_id = o.web_order_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled') AS utc_date_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01' AND status<>'cancelled') AS helsinki_count,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) = DATE '2025-12-01') AS helsinki_incl_cancelled,
       COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT web_order_id) AS dup_ids_total
FROM fact_web_order
